speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Singapore's research, innovation and enterprise efforts will play a key role in our future economy and in enabling Singapore to be a Smart Nation.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: NRF partners scientists, technologists, innovators, entrepreneurs, companies and Government agencies to transform our economy and society through knowledge and technology.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We seek to grow more innovative Singapore-based companies, create more good jobs for Singaporeans and improve the lives of Singaporeans.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Singapore has achieved a good standing internationally in R&D.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Our Universities and research institutes conduct high-quality R&D that creates economic and societal value for Singapore and Singaporeans.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Many international partners have set up R&D centres in Singapore.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We have catalysed new economic activity through strategic research programmes in sectors, such as Marine & Offshore, Satellite and Cybersecurity, which have attracted active participation from the industries.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: More companies are investing in corporate laboratories in our Universities and research institutes.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We have a vibrant and growing ecosystem of startups, venture capitalists, incubators and accelerators, leveraging Singapore's strengths as a financial centre and a trusted location to protect intellectual property.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: The growing number of successful companies based in Singapore or founded by Singaporeans, built from knowledge and technology created in Singapore, spur young Singaporeans to take up careers built around science and technology.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: These efforts will be aligned with the work of the Committee on the Future Economy.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Singapore must also leverage technology to seize new opportunities, become a Smart Nation and overcome our challenges.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Deployment of technologies to make our lives better, solve problems and address our needs is important to realise the benefits of our scientific enterprise and grow our companies' capacity for innovation.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We will build up capabilities of our Government agencies to lead in the use of new technologies and collaborate with companies to pilot and test-bed innovative solutions.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: The Government will also organise stakeholders across the national landscape and facilitate appropriate policies and regulations to enable new industries to grow.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We will upskill Singaporeans to play a central role in our research, innovation and enterprise efforts, while continuing to partner with and learn from the global community.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We will facilitate industry internships for our postgraduate research students to deepen skills and expand career choices.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: In a competitive world changing rapidly with technological advances, our research, innovation and enterprise efforts will be crucial to bringing Singapore and Singaporeans forward in the next stage of our development.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We must continue to invest in science and technology to support growth and innovation and exploit new knowledge to diversify and create new industries, so that Singapore continues to thrive as an island of opportunity where Singaporeans progress together.
